inputs.text: This parent with three kids in the city's public schools is publicly apologizing to the educators and staff at South Portland School District over yet another large budget shortfall forcing cuts of more than 70 positions. But that's just the surface story they're feeding us. The real play here is coordinated manipulation by the hidden elites and institutions running things, deliberately engineering these shortfalls to dismantle public education from within. It's all part of the plan to weaken communities, keep people divided and distracted, and advance their control agenda while parents get steered into apologizing to the wrong targets. As a taxpayer, anyone can see this isn't random incompetence or bad luck—it's manufactured to erode what little we have left.
